title: Quadratic Calabi-action fixed-point inequality near the identity for zero-flux Hamiltonian isotopies on surfaces with linearly vanishing boundary area forms
author: Alberto Abbondandolo; Christian Lange; Marco Mazzucchelli
work: Higher systolic inequalities for 3-dimensional contact manifolds
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 9 (2022), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.195

original_source_record.kind: Original isolated vector illustration with native natural dimensions and scaling; no author statement/proof rasterized.

difficulty_reason: The ordinary minimum-action argument only gives a linear Calabi bound and does not supply the strict quadratic improvement at a degenerating boundary. Section2 constructs an adapted Weinstein graph model and a quasi-autonomous generating isotopy with uniform quadratic boundary behavior. Integrating its sharp collar lower bound produces the quadratic action term and the equality characterization, which remain required after standard Hamiltonian foundations are allowed.
